title: SkyTek Scope of Work
description: Every field the SOW template uses. Each x-question is what to ask when the RFP does not answer it.

sow_date.description: Date on the cover, YYYY-MM-DD. Also used in the file name.
sow_date.x-question: What date should the SOW carry? (default: today)

client_name.x-question: What is the client's legal name?

client_signatory_name.description: Who signs for the client. Blank leaves a line to fill by hand.
client_signatory_name.x-question: Who signs for the client, if known?

client_signatory_title.description: Job title of the client signatory.
client_signatory_title.x-question: What is the client signatory's title?

project_title.description: Short project name on the cover and footer.

vendor_name.x-question: What is the vendor's legal name?

vendor_signatory_title.description: Job title of the vendor signatory.
vendor_signatory_title.x-question: What is the vendor signatory's title?

background.description: Why the client needs this work. Line breaks are kept.
background.x-question: In a few sentences, what problem is the client trying to solve?

objectives.description: Outcomes the work must achieve, one per bullet.
objectives.x-question: What outcomes must this work achieve?

out_of_scope.description: Work explicitly excluded. Empty prints 'No exclusions specified.'

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD or free text such as 'Week 4'.

deliverables.description: What is handed over, with a due date each.
deliverables.x-question: What will be delivered, and when is each item due?

start_date.description: Start of the engagement, YYYY-MM-DD or free text.

end_date.description: End of the engagement, YYYY-MM-DD or free text.

milestones.x-question: What are the key milestones and their dates?

roles.description: Who does what, vendor and client. Empty drops the section's table.
roles.x-question: What does each side (vendor and client) own?

assumptions.x-question: What assumptions does the estimate rely on (access, data, client availability)?

acceptance_criteria.description: How the client accepts deliverables. Line breaks are kept.
acceptance_criteria.x-question: How will the client accept deliverables (review window, sign-off)?

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD or IDR.

pricing_model.x-question: Is this fixed price, time and materials, or a retainer?

fees.description: Fee lines; the total is computed.
fees.x-question: What are the fee lines and amounts?

payment_schedule.x-question: When is each payment invoiced, and for how much?

payment_terms.x-question: What are the payment terms (e.g. Net 30)?

change_control.default: Either party may request a change to this SOW in writing. The vendor will assess the impact on scope, timeline and fees within five business days. No change takes effect until both parties sign a change order.
change_control.description: How scope changes are handled. Line breaks are kept.
change_control.x-question: Use the standard change-control clause, or a custom one?

governing_law.description: Jurisdiction, e.g. 'the Republic of Indonesia'. Empty omits the sentence.
governing_law.x-question: Which jurisdiction's law governs this SOW, if stated?

_sources.description: Where each field's value came from. Not rendered.
